title: Engine response to operation: stub (/io/response.json)
description: For the NOP gate (protocol §5, Stage 4): the base receives stubs of the new symbols so that a new test fails for the test and not for an import. The base's bodies and values are not touched: they could be the fix itself. With a non-null error, the core runs NOP without stubs.

stubbed.description: Files written to /io/stubs/<file>, each with the symbols that received a stub.

unstubbed.description: New symbols that the engine could not stub (e.g. a method of a nested class). A failure on the base that names them is invalid for NOP: INCONCLUSIVE.

modified_tests.description: Test ids (file::Class.method or file::func) whose body changed between base and candidate. The NOP gate judges them as new tests, because a changed test that fails on the base is a test that did not exist before. Empty when no test body changed.
